g.text: Top logic: reset = reset_pipe[3] (sw[15]); sw_sync = two-stage synchronization of sw[4:0].

g.text: OLED_SELF_TEST=0. SPI and board I2C are separate from the OLED I2C bus.

g.text: Dot = joined wires. Crossing without a dot = separate signals. [msb:lsb] = RTL vector width.
